legalConsent.checkboxLabel: I have read and accept the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
sections.body:
Ocean Flow — [PENDING: legal name, address and contact details of the data controller] is responsible for processing the personal data managed by this application.

For any question related to this policy, you can write to [PENDING: privacy contact email].

sections.heading: 2. What data we process
sections.body:
Account data: first name, last name, nickname and email.

Professional activity data: schools, activities, rates, classes taught, commissions and payments between colleagues that you record in the app.

Third-party data you enter: in some entries (for example, payments to colleagues) you may include the name of another person you work with professionally. You are responsible for making sure that person is aware of this processing.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose
sections.body: To help you keep track of your income as a freelance instructor: recording classes, commissions, payments and rates, and showing you summaries of your own activity.

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis
sections.body: The performance of the service relationship between you and Ocean Flow (providing the app). For third-party data you enter yourself, the basis is your legitimate interest in managing your professional activity.

sections.heading: 5. Retention
sections.body: Your data is kept for as long as you maintain an active Ocean Flow account. Data with tax or accounting relevance may be kept for as long as required by applicable law, even if you request the closure of your account.

sections.heading: 6. Data processors
sections.body: We use Supabase as our database and authentication provider, which acts as a data processor under its own security guarantees. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You can request access, rectification, erasure and portability of your data by writing to [PENDING: privacy contact email]. Some of these actions will be available directly from the app soon.

sections.heading: 8. Security
sections.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures (encryption in transit and at rest, per-user access control) to protect your data.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to this policy
sections.body: If we make a significant update to this policy, we'll ask you to accept it again the next time you access the app.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: These terms govern the use of Ocean Flow, an application for freelance diving instructors to keep track of their income (classes, commissions, payments between colleagues and rates).

sections.heading: 2. Access to the application
sections.body: Access to Ocean Flow is through a personal account created by an administrator. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity carried out from your account.

sections.heading: 3. Appropriate use
sections.body: You agree to use the application lawfully and to enter only truthful data related to your professional activity as an instructor.

sections.heading: 4. Third-party data
sections.body: If you record data about other people (for example, colleagues you share clients with), you declare that you have a legitimate basis to do so within the scope of your professional relationship with them.

sections.heading: 5. Service availability
sections.body: Ocean Flow is provided "as is", with no guarantee of continuous availability. We may carry out maintenance or make changes to the app that temporarily affect access.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual property
sections.body: The design, code and brand of Ocean Flow belong to its operator. The data you enter is yours; we process it as described in the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms. If the change is significant, we'll ask you to accept them again before you keep using the app.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
sections.body: For any question about these terms, write to [PENDING: contact email].
